fields.features_heading: What the Sheet Settles Before the Party Starts
fields.features_subheading: A valentine's day party sign up sheet decides who brings what. Emergent builds it as a small app that keeps the count for you.
fields.feature_1:
A party sheet drafted from a sentence

Describe a class party where parents bring snacks and supplies. Emergent builds the sign-up form and its database, then changes both whenever you ask for it in plain English.
fields.feature_2:
Items that drop off once they are claimed

Each treat or supply has a set number of slots. When its last slot fills, the item leaves the list, and the next parent picks from what is open, not a third tray of cookies.
fields.feature_3:
A card count taken from the class list

Load the class list once, and the sheet tells each family how many valentines to bring, one per classmate. The email each family gets carries every first name for the cards.
fields.feature_4:
A reminder email the day before

The app emails each parent what they signed up to bring and when to drop it off. Move the drop-off time, and the update reaches every parent on the sheet, not only the group chat.
fields.feature_5:
Sign-ups kept in a database you own

Every sign-up lands in a database you own, with no cap on responses. Next February's room parent starts from this year's party items and who brought them, not a blank page.
fields.feature_6:
Full code for your own GitHub repository

On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository. A PTO that runs several class parties a year can host the sheet next to its other school pages and keep editing it.

fields.usecase_heading: Who Signs Up, and What They Bring
fields.tab_content_1:
Of 14 items, cupcakes are taken and 3 are still open

Room 12's party list at Saybrook Elementary has 14 items, and 11 of the 14 are claimed. When Oriana Tuckerman picks cupcakes, the sheet tells her the Gilderoy family already has them and offers the 3 items still open. Room parent Nettie Ketteridge gets the final list by email once every item is claimed.
fields.tab_content_2:
Every family brings 21 cards to a class of 22

Valentine cards are the one job every family in Ms. Tellfair's class at Valbonne Elementary shares. With 22 students, each family is asked for 21 cards, one per classmate. The sheet emails every family the first names to write on them. So far 18 of the 22 families have confirmed, and 4 have not.
fields.tab_content_3:
The potluck is 3 sides short of its 15 dishes

Jolene Cosgrove stopped the dessert pileup at the Sventek Dental Group Valentine's lunch by giving each category its own slots: 4 mains, 6 sides, and 5 desserts. Desserts filled first. With 12 of 15 dishes claimed, sides are 3 short, and a category with open slots is named in an email to Jolene.
fields.tab_content_4:
Waitlist guests get any seat a couple gives back

Seats go fast at the Leland Park Senior Center sweetheart dance: all 120 are taken, and 9 guests wait on the list. When the Iveson couple cancels, the sheet emails Edna Hatherleigh, first in line, an offer for the 2 freed seats with 24 hours to accept. Coordinator Roderick Loveday sees her offer marked pending.

fields.howto_title: How to Plan a Valentine's Party Sign-Up Sheet
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to set up a valentine's day party sign up sheet that covers every item and job, then build it with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Decide what kind of party it is
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Check the food rules with the teacher
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Name each item with a quantity
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Count the cards from the class list
fields.howto_step_1_des: A class party, an office potluck, and a dance each need a different sheet. A class party runs on a supply list, a potluck on dish categories, and a dance on a seat count. Pick one before you write a single line.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Ask the teacher whether the class allows homemade treats and whether any food is kept out of the room. If the class is nut-free, put that at the top of the sheet and next to every food item parents can claim.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Write 2 dozen cupcakes or 30 juice boxes rather than dessert or drinks. Give every item its own number of slots. List paper goods and craft supplies as items too: plates and glue sticks need a name next to them as much as the cupcakes do.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Each child brings one card per classmate, which is the class size minus one. Collect first names only, check the spelling with the teacher, and send the list early enough for younger kids to write the names themselves.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Set a drop-off time and a reminder
fields.howto_step_5_des: Choose when items arrive, such as at morning drop-off on party day or the afternoon before. Send a reminder the day before with the item and the time, and tell parents who to contact if they cannot bring it.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Test it as a parent on your phone
fields.howto_step_6_des: Sign up as a made-up parent from your own phone. Claim an item, then try to claim it again from a second test entry and check that the sheet refuses. Read the confirmation email, then delete the test rows.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Post the link in the class newsletter about 2 weeks before February 14. Close sign-ups 3 days ahead, which leaves time to buy whatever is still unclaimed or ask the class for one more volunteer.

faq_plan.q: What is a valentine's day party sign up sheet?
faq_plan.ref: valentine's day party sign up sheet
faq_plan.a: A valentine's day party sign up sheet is a list where parents or guests claim what they will bring or do for a Valentine's party. Each line pairs one person with an item or a job. The organizer reads it to see what is covered and what is still missing before February 14.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a valentine's day party sign up sheet?
faq_plan.ref: valentine's day party sign up sheet
faq_plan.a: Describe the party to Emergent's AI form builder in a sentence or two: the class or group, the items you need, and how many of each. Emergent writes the form and the database that holds each claim. Share the link with parents, and change the sheet later by describing the change in plain English.

faq_plan.q: What items go on a valentine's day party sign up sheet for a classroom?
faq_plan.a: Put the treats first, such as cupcakes or fruit, each with a quantity. Then add drinks, plates, napkins, and the craft supplies for making card holders. Ask each parent for a name and an email address, and put the party date and the drop-off time at the top.

faq_plan.q: How many lines should a valentine's day party sign up sheet have?
faq_plan.a: List about one item per family, which keeps any single parent from carrying the whole party. For a class of 22, that means up to 22 lines, or fewer if some parents take a job on the day instead. Count plates and craft supplies as items alongside the food.

faq_plan.q: Can a valentine's day party sign up sheet include volunteer jobs?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Add each job as an item with its own slots, such as running the craft table or cleaning up afterward. Give every job a start time and a length. A parent can then tell whether it means 20 minutes after the last bell or staying for the whole party.

faq_plan.q: How do I note food allergies on a valentine's day party sign up sheet?
faq_plan.a: Open the sheet with the class food rules in the teacher's words, and repeat them next to each food item. Add an ingredients field to every food item so parents list what they are bringing. Leave decisions about any one child to the teacher and the school.

faq_plan.q: How do I stop duplicate items on a valentine's day party sign up sheet?
faq_plan.a: Give each item a fixed number of slots and close it once they are full. On paper, that means crossing items off by hand as names go in. Emergent builds the sheet with that limit from a one-sentence description, and the next parent sees only the items still open.

faq_plan.q: What if a parent drops out of a valentine's day party sign up sheet?
faq_plan.a: Ask parents to release the item on the sheet rather than by text, which reopens it for another family. Keep a short list of backups you can buy yourself, such as napkins or juice. Check the sheet the day before the party for anything released late.

faq_plan.q: How do I set up a valentine's day party sign up sheet for an office lunch?
faq_plan.a: Split the dishes into categories with a set number of slots each, sized to the headcount. For 30 people, 4 mains, 8 sides, and 6 desserts is a workable start. Responses on an Emergent sheet have no cap, and a sheet for 30 coworkers runs the same way for 300.

faq_plan.q: How do I send reminders from a valentine's day party sign up sheet?
faq_plan.a: Send each parent one reminder the day before the party with the item, the quantity, and the drop-off time. A group message reaches everyone but rarely names the item. The sheet Emergent builds can send that email from each sign-up, and the record stays in a database you own.

faq_heading: Valentine's Day Party Sign-Up Sheet FAQ

plan.angle: The top 10 for valentine's day party sign up sheet is printables: Etsy and Teachers Pay Teachers sheets, Pinterest pins and free potluck PDFs, each a grid of blank lines for a name and an item. A paper grid cannot tell the third parent that cupcakes are already covered, cannot hand every family the class list for cards, and cannot fill a seat when a guest cancels. This page shows the sheet as a small app for four Valentine's jobs: a room parent filling a classroom supply list, a teacher sending each family the names for cards, an office potluck split into dish categories, and a senior center dance with a seat limit and a waitlist. The FAQ covers what to list, timing, allergies, volunteers and reminders.
